recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future cleanup of ordinary web links that still use www.hl7.org/fhir should be handled as separate link-canonicalization work, not as a remaining FHIR-5574 code-system fix.
issue_request: FHIR-5574 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction for DSTU1 ValueSet terminology that requested removal of the www. prefix from code system URIs such as http://www.hl7.org/fhir/contracttypecodes, contracttermtypecodes, payment/contract type, contractsubtypecodes, contracttermsubtypecodes, processoutcomecodes, and contractsignertypecodes.
initial_application: Git history contains the Jira-tagged application commits: 3a02354c0bb7183b06faec216afe712c7b841560 (#5574/SVN 3977) changed the affected contract, payment reconciliation, status/process outcome, and example system URIs from http://www.hl7.org/fhir/... to http://hl7.org/fhir/..., and 6a9b86cc7bd1f7fe02ff9487e10d67106e19e854 (#5574/SVN 4213) changed the remaining non-system base URL occurrences noted in the Jira comments.
additional_context: Current source has since moved several affected example systems to terminology.hl7.org CodeSystem URLs. Contract and PaymentReconciliation are active/approved in source/fhir.ini, while ProcessResponse is a removed/commented legacy resource; the remaining processoutcomecodes source is also no-www. The current combined branch still has a few ordinary http://www.hl7.org/fhir/... web links to external IG pages, but no system, url, or valueSet declarations with the obsolete www-prefixed FHIR base were found. Zulip and Confluence searches found no FHIR-5574-specific community record that changes the conclusion.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The reconciliation published an empty audit commit because the current combined branch already satisfies the issue's code-system URI correction.
